title: Lectin C Gene Analysis
author: Tran Vinh Phuong
materials: RevertAid First Strand cDNA Synthesis kit

steps.title: Purify total RNA
steps.instruction: Purify total RNA from mammalian tissue using the GeneJET RNA Purification Kit (Thermo Scientific, USA).

steps.title: Synthesize first‑strand cDNA
steps.instruction: Perform first‑strand cDNA synthesis with the RevertAid First Strand cDNA Synthesis kit (Thermo Fisher Scientific, USA) using 0 µL as indicated.

steps.title: Purify PCR products
steps.instruction: Purify PCR products using the GeneJET Gel Extraction kit (Thermo Scientific, USA).

steps.title: Clone into pGEM‑T Easy
steps.instruction: Clone the purified PCR insert into the pGEM‑T Easy vector (Promega, USA).

steps.title: Isolate plasmid DNA
steps.instruction: Isolate plasmid DNA using the GeneJET Plasmid Miniprep Kit (Thermo Fisher Scientific, USA).

steps.title: Translate to amino acids
steps.instruction: Translate the nucleotide sequence to an amino‑acid sequence using the Expasy translation tool.

steps.title: Predict protein domains
steps.instruction: Predict protein domains using the SMART web server.

steps.title: Predict protein structure
steps.instruction: Predict the three‑dimensional protein structure using Phyre2.

steps.title: Predict isoelectric point
steps.instruction: Predict the protein isoelectric point using IPC2.
